title: VRP Peers v0.1 (experimental)
description: The optional `peers` member of a VRP discovery document (spec/peers-v0.1.md): the domains of other VRP nodes this node knows, and nothing else. Not part of Core conformance; the Core discovery schema is unchanged. An entry is no trust relation, endorsement or ranking: each listed domain proves itself at its own domain. Rules this grammar cannot express are runtime rules in spec/peers-v0.1.md §3–§4: ascending order, the Public Suffix List and closed top-level domains, and that an entry is not the listing node's own canonical_domain.

items.description: A domain written as Core §2 item 1 writes canonical_domain: lowercase ASCII, A-labels, at least two labels, no trailing dot, no scheme, path, port or userinfo. The trailing (?!\n) keeps engines whose $ also matches before a final line break from accepting one (ADR 0012 D3).

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC: when the publisher last changed nodes. States nothing about any listed node.
